name: Cliff test (volume terrain prototype)
note: A small place made of cliffs, to compare the two ways of drawing the ground: a limestone sea coast with stacks and an arch, an escarpment with a town on its edge, and a gorge with a river and a bridge. The Volume ground switch draws it as one 3D surface. Not Stones Hold.

views.name: Sea cliffs
views.note: Limestone cliffs straight out of the sea, a notch cut at the waterline, stacks and an arch offshore.

views.name: The arch
views.note: The sea arch from the water.

views.name: The gorge
views.note: The river in its gorge, the bridge high over it.

views.name: Edge Town
views.note: A white town on the edge of the escarpment.

views.name: The whole place
views.note: Upland, escarpment, gorge and sea cliffs.
